subject: Model comparison and number of samples for each model

messages.author: 90b5ae7e2259370d
messages.subject: Model comparison and number of samples for each model
parts:
Dear all,

if I want to compare two models (for example using WAIC), do I need to draw the same number of samples per model? I'm asking because say I have 10 models and then the 10th model turns out to not converge, so I need to increase the sample size, it would take quite a long time to re-run every other model as well with that sample size.

Many thanks
Jacquie

messages.author: a236d3d356ca53fd
messages.subject: Re: Model comparison and number of samples for each model
parts:
You can use different number of samples per model.

I recommend to use loo package as it gives warrnings if WAIC computation is likely to have large error (and then recommends using more robust PSIS-LOO instead)

Aki
